::: {style="text-align: block;"}
My little self have been fascinated by nature from the early days of my existence, watching stunning documentaries of David Attenborough and reading about fascinating life discoveries of Mr. Darwin, Wallace, Diamond, Wilson, Einstein, Feynman, Verne, London, Exupéry, Nowak, Wittgenstein, Saint Francis of Assisi and many others.

Later I decided to pursue studies in ecological and evolutionary biology, which remain at the core of my scientific interests. This goes hand in hand with my inclination to spatial patterns, which evolved over the hundreds of hours spent as a child moving little wooden soldiers across the carpet in my room and reconstructing an ancient battles on the maps. Just recently I dived more deeply into current paradigm of evolutionary theory, especially into evolutionary dynamics and evolution of cooperation. Together, these topics point to my general interest into complex adaptive systems.

Nowadays I live as the curious human being, the man who wants to be aware of the presence in this marvelous constantly changing world. Do you want to know me better? Write me an email and we can talk over some tasty beverage!

And always remember dear friend, knowledge is just knowledge, nothing more.
:::
